text:
Mia Chen: Kicking off the weighted DNS shift for APAC->EU edge traffic in 30m (14:00 UTC). I'm the owner for the window.
Raj Patel: Ack - I'll be on-call for any routing fallout. Confirming dedicated EU pool has spare capacity (~35%).
Sophia Gomez: Quick checklist before we start:
- TTL = 60s on the record
- Canary to 5% for 5m -> 25% for 10m -> 50% for 15m -> 100%
- Smoke: /health 200, p95 < 220ms, error_rate <0.5%
Mia Chen: Plan: update weighted record in Route53, monitor edge traces + logs, then bump weights per schedule. TTL 60 set already.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by @Mia Chen for 1764127890 at 14:00 UTC :rocket:
Eric L.: I'm going to run the pre-change smoke now (svc-check script). If it fails I'll ping here.
Mia Chen: paste the smoke result here, @Eric L. If any failures stop roll and set weights back to previous.
Eric L.: smoke ok locally: all services return 200, p95 140ms, errors 0.08% :thumbsup:
Sophia Gomez: Also note Cloudflare LB health: eu-primary pool ok, apac pool green but CPU at 65%. If we exceed 80% we'll pause.
Raj Patel: I'll watch the dashboards. Alert thresholds set: latency_p95 >300ms OR error_rate >1% -> @oncall and @mia will get page.
Mia Chen: CLI I'll run to change weights (example):
```
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z12345 --change-batch '{"Changes": [{"Action": "UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet": {"Name": "edge.redwood.ai.","Type": "A","SetIdentifier": "eu-edge","Weight": 5,"TTL": 60,"ResourceRecords": [{"Value": "1.2.3.4"}]}}]}'
```
Sophia Gomez: That sets eu to 5%. We'll keep apac at 95. After 5m check metrics and proceed to 25%.
Raj Patel: If rollback needed: run same cmd to set weights back to apac 100 / eu 0 and flush CDN. Also we have a CanaryModel variant pinned—roll back to model v1.9 if inference errors occur.
Mia Chen: Timeline reminder: 14:00 start, 14:05 -> 25, 14:15 -> 50, 14:30 -> 100. I'll post step done messages.
ops-watchdog-bot: Note: during shift no config changes to autoscaler. If CPU >85% autoscaler will scale but may cause brief lat spikes.
Eric L.: After 5m canary: p95 155ms, errors 0.12% — all good, pushing to 25% now.
Mia Chen: Done -> 25% :white_check_mark:
Raj Patel: Watching logs, no increase in 5xx, error_rate stable.
Sophia Gomez: Proceeding to 50% in 10m per plan unless anyone objects.
Mia Chen: no objections, go for it.
Eric L.: 50% done. Monitoring.
Mia Chen: Any anomalies call the rollback and I'll flip weights back.
Raj Patel: All green, bumping to 100%.
Mia Chen: 100% complete. Shifting final DNS TTL back to 300 in 20m.
Sophia Gomez: Closing note: saved the change-batch JSON to s3://redwood-deploys/1764127890-weighted-change.json and added runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/edge-dns-shifts
Mia Chen: Thanks everyone, great coordination. I'll update the release doc and mark this done.
